newsitem.title: UK: BOE issues consultative papers on UK gilt market.
newsitem.headline: BOE issues consultative papers on UK gilt market.

text.p: The Bank of England on Monday said it had issued three consultative papers on the UK gilt market and its conventions.

The first paper covers possible changes to the ex-dividend period with one possibility that the ex-dividend period be abolished altogether for gilts held at the Central Gilts Office (CGO), and limited elsewhere.

The second invites views on changes to market conventions, including the daycount convention used for the calculation of accrued interest and the quotation of gilt prices, which is currently in fractions.

"The changes were identified as meriting consideration in the report recently published of a working group established by the Bank to consider the implications of EMU for the gilts market," the Bank said in a statement.
The third paper covers calculating strip prices from yields.
Comments on all three papers are invited by February 28, the Bank said.
